name: Toro Energy Limited
content: Toro Energy Limited is an Australian-based uranium exploration and development company primarily focused on its flagship Wiluna Uranium Project in Western Australia. The project consists of several deposits, including Centipede, Millipede, Lake Maitland, and Lake Way, making it one of the most advanced uranium projects in the region. In addition to its uranium assets, the company explores for nickel, gold, and base metals through its Dusty Nickel Project and other regional exploration programs. Toro Energy aims to become a significant uranium producer to support the global transition toward clean energy and nuclear power.

Officers

Richard Homsany(Date: 2013 December)

Executive Chairman

Mr Homsany is an experienced corporate lawyer and has over 30 years’ experience in the resources sector. He is the Executive Chairman of Toro Energy Limited and also serves as the Chairman of Healthia Limited and Galan Lithium Limited. He has extensive experience in corporate law, finance, and management within the mining industry.

Katherine Irelan(Date: 2016 January)

Chief Financial Officer

Ms Irelan is a Chartered Accountant with over 20 years of experience in the resource sector, specializing in financial management, corporate governance, and statutory reporting. She has held various senior financial roles in ASX-listed companies.

Directors

Richard Homsany(Date: 2013 December)

Executive Chairman

Mr Homsany is an experienced corporate lawyer and has over 30 years’ experience in the resources sector. He is the Executive Chairman of Toro Energy Limited and also serves as the Chairman of Healthia Limited and Galan Lithium Limited.

Richard Patricio(Date: 2015 December)

Non-Executive Director

Mr Patricio is a lawyer and the President and CEO of Mega Uranium Ltd. He has over 20 years of experience in the mining sector, specifically in uranium. He serves on the boards of several publicly listed companies including NexGen Energy Ltd and ISOEnergy Ltd.

Michel Marier(Date: 2015 December)

Non-Executive Director

Mr Marier is a co-founder and partner of Integrated Asset Management (IAM). He has extensive experience in private equity and infrastructure investments. He previously held senior positions at Sentient Asset Management Canada.
